product.name: Archive Bridge (synthetic example)
product.description: Fictional local stdio MCP server for a document store. This payload demonstrates shape and gating; no real product was tested.

environments_examined: synthetic test harness; no real installation
assumptions: MCP-part demonstration only; general security/data/package/deployment parts are outside this example scope.
limitations: All evidence is synthetic. This is neither a real audit nor a whole-product readiness decision.
Host-side consent and remote discovery protections have no observed evidence.

summary: Illustrative HOLD: critical isolation is unverified. The host boundary and URL handling also need evidence. All evidence below is simulated.
